metadata.case_name: LUK KA WAI v. LEE YUK CHUN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: moderate degree of deep burns (scalding) of multiple areas
source: She was rushed to Kwong Wah Hospital, where she was found to have a moderate degree of deep burns of the following areas:
(1) Lower part of chin
(2) Front of chest
(3) Medial aspect of right forearm
(4) Medial aspect of left arm
(5) Area between the proximal and distal phalanges of the middle three fingers of left arm
(6) Dorsal aspect of the proximal phalangeal area of left ring and middle fingers
(7) Lateral aspect of the base of left thumb
(8) Front of left thigh
(9) Right side of buttock
(10) Medial part of right thigh

injuries.description: hypertrophic scarring / keloid scarring (residual scarring) affecting multiple areas
source: 1. Front of chest 7.5 x 4 inches - scarring was fairly extensive with congested raised areas at the upper part.
2. Front of left thigh 5 x 2.5 inches - congested scarring.
3. Front of right thigh 2 x 1.5 inches - congested scarring.
4. Back of right thigh 5.5 x 2 inches - pale scarring.
5. Inner side of right arm 1.5 x 1 inch - pale scarring.
6. Inner side of left forearm 2 x 1.5 inches - congested scarring.
7. Left 2nd to 4th fingers - circumferential pale scarring.
8. Underside of chin and upper part of neck - pale scarring.
(1) The scalded area at the front of the right thigh now shows further evidence of hypertrophy, and colour changes resulting in an obvious hypertrophic scar measuring 5" x 2".
(2) Similar worsening of hypertrophic scar, much more evident now at front of chest measuring 3" x 1.75".
(3) Similar hypertrophic scarring at inner side of right arm.

It was Dr. Lee's opinion from those findings that hypertrophic scarring (keloids) were going to be established and would be likely to give great distress to the child and the parents, as the cosmetic, as well as the physical effects would be of great concern to both.

manifestations.description: considerable pain and suffering at the time of the accident and for a long time afterwards. She cried continuously for several days and thereafter periodically for a month during winter she complained of pain. She cried loudly after debridement operations, and had to be subdued by nursing staff.
After being discharged from hospital the child cried a lot at night for the first couple of weeks and slowly settled down, although she was hot-tempered compared with her previously calm nature.
prominent keloid scars causing considerable inhibition, embarrassment and sorrow as she matures into a woman
restricted to non-revealing clothing in a mainly tropical climate
the site of scarring could possibly impede development of the left breast / possible malformation of the left breast due to scar contracture

treatments_received: several painful debridement treatments in the operating theatre
treatments_future: possible skin graft over the left breast to relieve contracture

losses.description: residual claw-like scarring on parts of her body which are particularly important to a female, which will be the source of considerable inhibition, embarrassment and sorrow to her as she matures into a woman
restricted to non-revealing clothing in a mainly tropical climate, and will experience some physical discomfort from chaffing
